items.prompt:
Which takes a LONGER time?
A) A quick journal reflection
B) A multi-day research report

steps: Reports take longer. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Which is a SHORT writing task?
A) A five-minute response
B) A week-long essay with sources

Writing often builds skill and:
A) stamina
B) height
C) hunger

steps: Practice builds stamina. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which task would take SEVERAL DAYS?
A) a quick text message
B) a research report with sources
C) a one-line note
items.answer: B) a research report with sources

solution.answer: B) a research report with sources

items.prompt:
A quick reflection is best described as a:
A) short writing task
B) long project
C) book

Longer pieces of writing usually need:
A) planning, research, and revision
B) erasers only
C) nothing

steps: More steps for big pieces. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Why do teachers ask students to write often, both short and long pieces?
A) It builds writing skill and stamina
B) To use up paper
C) Writing never improves
items.answer: A) It builds writing skill and stamina

steps: Routine writing builds skill. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) It builds writing skill and stamina

items.prompt:
Which plan best fits a LONG research report?
A) Plan, research, draft, and revise over several days
B) Write it all in five minutes
C) Never start it
items.answer: A) Plan, research, draft, and revise over several days

steps: Long pieces take time and steps. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Plan, research, draft, and revise over several days
